bookings.briefTitle: Vitamin C Brightening Serum Launch Review
bookings.briefDescription: We need an honest, detailed review of our new Vitamin C Brightening Serum. Cover the unboxing experience, texture, scent, application, and visible results after 7 days of use. Target audience is women 25-40 interested in clean beauty. Mention our cruelty-free and vegan certifications.

bookings.briefTitle: Wireless Earbuds Pro Max Unboxing & First Look
bookings.briefDescription: Unbox our new Wireless Earbuds Pro Max on camera. Highlight the premium packaging, magnetic charging case, active noise cancellation demo, and sound quality test with different music genres. Compare briefly with AirPods Pro 2. Tone should be enthusiastic but honest.

Use our Vanilla Bean Plant Protein Powder daily for 2 weeks and document your experience. Cover taste, mixability, ingredient transparency, and how it fits into your post-workout routine. Include B-roll of making a shake and a gym session. Be candid about any negatives.

Create a cinematic lookbook featuring 4-5 outfits from our Eid 2025 collection. Style each outfit for a different occasion — casual day out, iftar dinner, Eid prayer, family gathering, and evening celebration. Shoot against Dubai's architectural backdrops. Include brand tags and shopping link CTA.

Showcase our new Rose Hydrating Face Mist. Demonstrate the spray, show the dewy finish on skin, and share your genuine thoughts on scent and hydration. Highlight that it's suitable for all skin tones. Vibrant, energetic editing style preferred.

deliverables.notes: First draft of the skincare serum review. Includes unboxing, texture demo, and 7-day results montage. Let me know if you'd like any adjustments to the pacing or CTA placement.

bookings.briefTitle: Living Room Transformation with HomeVibe Collection
bookings.briefDescription: Transform a living room space using pieces from our new Tropical Brights collection — including the rattan armchair, ceramic planters, and woven throw pillows. Before-and-after format with time-lapse assembly. Warm, inviting aesthetic that appeals to young homeowners in Latin America.

Full review of our new Luxe EV-X electric SUV. Cover exterior design, interior features, driving dynamics, range test, and charging experience. Film along scenic Irish roads. Tone should be premium but accessible — we want to attract first-time EV buyers.

deliverables.notes: First cut of the EV-X review. Includes drone shots of the exterior, interior walkthrough, and a driving segment along the Ring of Kerry. Waiting for feedback on the pacing and whether you want more focus on the tech features.

bookings.briefTitle: RGB Mechanical Keyboard Review for Gamers
bookings.briefDescription: Review our new MechStrike Pro RGB mechanical keyboard. Cover the typing feel (Cherry MX switches), RGB customisation software, build quality, and gaming performance across FPS and MOBA titles. Include sound test and comparison with your current keyboard.
